correctness.rationale: The exact 16-vertex, 24-edge graph and induced-forest predicate were reconstructed. Independently enumerated all 65536 vertex masks: 50997 faces including empty, face vector (1,16,120,560,1820,4368,7984,11200,11792,8672,3792,672), reduced Euler -21. Reimplemented the greedy pivot match and obtained 25483 pairs, 31 critical faces (one dimension 8, 26 dimension 9, four dimension 10); independently topologically sorted all 375056 directed Hasse incidences. Exact signed gradient projection gives d9 with seven +1 entries and 19 zeros, and d10=0. The primitive unit cancels the 8-cell with a 9-cell. On the residual wedge of 25 S9 the four 10-cell attaching maps are in pi9=Z25 and vanish with their boundary coefficients, proving the claimed integral homotopy. This is exhaustive finite proof, not mere mod-two evidence.

evidence: The example is noncactus: 24 edges, 16 vertices, 9-dimensional cycle space, girth six; cactus cycles with 24 edges and girth six number at most four.
broader_coverage.reasoning: General methods can be applied but inspected all-graph conclusions do not give its complete homotopy without the 65536-case Morse certificate.

value.rationale: The vertex-induced forest complex of a natural cubic, highly cyclic, 16-vertex symmetric graph has a nontrivial mixed-dimensional integral sphere-wedge homotopy; this determines homotopy rather than only Betti ranks and demonstrates an exact computable boundary beyond cactus families. Its finite scope is explicit and does not require a whole family theorem.
